## Recommended global consideration set

As of **August 2026**, an owner should not select a residential flag simply because it is the hotel brand already preferred for the project. The correct shortlist depends on the residential buyer profile, achievable pricing, location, unit mix, operating model and brand-fee burden.

Savills’ 2025–26 data identifies **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W, Aman, Fairmont, Address, Waldorf Astoria, Mandarin Oriental and Westin** as the ten largest hotel-branded residential brands by completed projects. Marriott and Accor lead at parent-company level, while Four Seasons has unusually strong scale for a single-brand operator. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/Savills-Branded-Residences-Annual-Report-2025-2026.pdf))

### 1. Core ultra-luxury shortlist

These should normally be tested for a trophy urban project or top-tier destination resort:

| Brand | Particularly suitable for | Principal consideration |
|---|---|---|
| **Four Seasons** | Trophy urban, resort and standalone residences | Probably the strongest all-around residential operating proposition; highly selective and service-intensive |
| **The Ritz-Carlton** | Urban towers, resorts and large mixed-use projects | Powerful global recognition and Marriott distribution |
| **Ritz-Carlton Reserve** | Low-density destination resorts | Scarcer and more exclusive than the core Ritz-Carlton flag |
| **St. Regis** | Formal urban luxury, legacy and resort markets | Strong recognition among international luxury buyers |
| **Mandarin Oriental** | Global gateway cities and sophisticated resorts | Strong service, spa and Asian/European buyer appeal; its portfolio includes operating and pipeline residences across major global cities and resorts ([mandarinoriental.com](https://www.mandarinoriental.com/en/residences?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Rosewood** | Design-led, highly localized urban and resort projects | “Sense of place” positioning works well when architecture and location are distinctive ([rosewoodhotels.com](https://www.rosewoodhotels.com/residences?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Aman** | Ultra-low-density resorts and highly exclusive urban projects | Exceptional scarcity and pricing potential, but requires unusually strong site, design and privacy ([aman.com](https://www.aman.com/residences?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Raffles** | Heritage buildings, landmark urban projects and grand resorts | Best where history, glamour and high-touch service are central to the concept ([raffles.com](https://www.raffles.com/residences/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Waldorf Astoria** | Trophy urban and resort mixed-use | Strong luxury recognition with Hilton scale; Hilton reports a meaningful premium in its Las Vegas conversion case study ([hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/corporate/residential-development/)) |
| **One&Only** | Destination resorts, villas and private-home communities | Particularly strong for experiential, low-density resort ownership with rental-program potential ([oneandonlyresorts.com](https://www.oneandonlyresorts.com/private-homes?utm_source=openai)) |

**Practical first-round ultra-luxury RFP:** Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood, Aman, Raffles and Waldorf Astoria—then add One&Only, Six Senses or Ritz-Carlton Reserve for a resort.

---

### 2. Larger multi-brand platforms

These groups are useful when an owner wants several positioning alternatives from one organization.

#### Marriott International

Marriott offers **16 residential brands**, giving it the broadest readily accessible range from ultra-luxury through premium residential. ([marriottresidences.com](https://marriottresidences.com/brands/?utm_source=openai))

Consider:

- **The Ritz-Carlton**
- **Ritz-Carlton Reserve**
- **St. Regis**
- **EDITION**
- **The Luxury Collection**
- **W**
- **JW Marriott**
- **Westin**
- **Autograph Collection**
- **Marriott Hotels**
- **Le Méridien**
- **Renaissance**
- **Sheraton**
- **Tribute Portfolio**

Best reasons to shortlist Marriott are global buyer recognition, Bonvoy reach, established residential standards and the ability to calibrate the flag to several price points. **EDITION and W** suit lifestyle buyers; **JW Marriott and Westin** can support a broader luxury buyer pool; **Luxury Collection and Autograph Collection** offer more property individuality.

#### Accor / Ennismore

Accor reports more than **25 residential brand offerings and 130-plus projects under development**, supported by its Accor One Living mixed-use platform. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/hotel-development/solutions-for-every-project?mdrv=group.accor.com))

Consider:

- **Raffles**
- **Fairmont**
- **Sofitel / Sofitel Legend**
- **SLS**
- **SO/**
- **Mondrian**
- **Faena**
- **Delano**
- **MGallery**
- **Pullman**
- **Swissôtel**
- **Mövenpick**

Accor is especially relevant in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific and markets where an owner wants a choice between classical luxury and lifestyle positioning. **Fairmont** has one of the sector’s longest residential track records; **SLS, SO/ and Mondrian** fit more energetic, design- and entertainment-led projects.

#### Hilton

Hilton’s trading and pipeline residential portfolio covers **nine brands and more than 9,000 units**. ([hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/corporate/residential-development/))

Primary candidates:

- **Waldorf Astoria**
- **Conrad**
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
- **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**

Waldorf Astoria is the priority at trophy level; Conrad can work for contemporary luxury with somewhat broader buyer appeal.

#### Hyatt

Hyatt reports more than **50 open or pipeline residential projects** across brands including Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson, The Standard and Miraval. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-30-2025-unscriptedbyhyatt))

Consider:

- **Park Hyatt**
- **Andaz**
- **Thompson Hotels**
- **The Standard**
- **Alila**
- **Miraval**
- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**

Park Hyatt is the strongest traditional luxury candidate. Andaz, Thompson and The Standard are better for younger, design-conscious urban or resort buyers; Miraval is a specialized wellness proposition.

#### IHG

Consider:

- **Six Senses**
- **Regent**
- **InterContinental**
- **Kimpton**

Of these, **Six Senses** has the most differentiated residential proposition, particularly around wellness, sustainability, nature and resort living. It now has residences in urban, beach, mountain and standalone formats. ([sixsenses.com](https://www.sixsenses.com/en/residences/?utm_source=openai))

---

### 3. Specialist brands worth adding by project type

#### Resort, wellness and low-density villas

- **Six Senses**
- **One&Only**
- **Aman**
- **Rosewood**
- **Ritz-Carlton Reserve**
- **Banyan Tree**
- **Auberge Resorts Collection**
- **Montage**
- **Capella**
- **Four Seasons**

These brands generally work best when the land, natural setting, privacy and amenity program are genuinely exceptional—not merely when the development needs a luxury name.

#### Lifestyle and design-led urban projects

- **EDITION**
- **W**
- **SLS**
- **SO/**
- **Mondrian**
- **Faena**
- **Andaz**
- **Thompson**
- **The Standard**
- **Pendry**
- **Nobu**

These can create stronger differentiation than traditional luxury brands, but their buyer pool may be more style-sensitive and the residences must deliver the brand identity without making permanent living feel like an extended nightclub or hotel stay.

#### Regionally powerful candidates

- **Address Hotels + Resorts** — especially Middle East and South Asia
- **Jumeirah** — particularly GCC and luxury source markets familiar with Dubai
- **Banyan Tree** — Asia-Pacific and resort markets
- **Kempinski** — Europe, Middle East, Africa and selected Asian markets
- **Montage / Pendry** — North America, Mexico and selected resort markets
- **Auberge Resorts Collection** — North America, Caribbean and Mexico
- **Capella** — Asia-Pacific and highly selective global luxury markets
- **Fasano** — Brazil and parts of Latin America

Jumeirah, for example, is actively expanding both whole-ownership Jumeirah Residences and serviced Jumeirah Living products, although its brand equity is currently strongest in the Middle East. ([jumeirah.com](https://www.jumeirah.com/en/jumeirah-group/portfolio?utm_source=openai))

## How I would build the shortlist

For most projects, invite **six to ten brands**, not 25:

1. **Two global ultra-luxury leaders**  
   Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis or Mandarin Oriental.

2. **Two project-specific specialists**  
   For example Aman and One&Only for a secluded resort, or Rosewood and Raffles for a landmark urban project.

3. **Two scalable alternatives**  
   Fairmont, Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, JW Marriott, Park Hyatt or InterContinental.

4. **One or two lifestyle alternatives**  
   EDITION, W, SLS, Andaz, Thompson or Pendry.

5. **One regionally dominant brand**  
   Address, Jumeirah, Banyan Tree, Kempinski, Montage, Auberge or another brand with strong recognition among the project’s actual source markets.

## Owner evaluation criteria

The final decision should be based on a quantified scorecard covering:

- **Residential price premium and sales velocity**, using local—not global—comparables.
- **Buyer recognition in the project’s actual source markets.**
- **Existing residential operating record**, not simply hotel count.
- **Hotel/residence amenity sharing and cost allocation.**
- **Residential staffing model and HOA/service-charge affordability.**
- **Technical standards and incremental construction cost.**
- **Upfront license, marketing, design-review and ongoing royalty fees.**
- **Rental-program structure, owner-use restrictions and securities/tax implications.**
- **Brand exclusivity, territorial protection and competing pipeline.**
- **Operator performance obligations and owner approval rights.**
- **Termination, debranding and replacement-operator provisions.**
- **Brand commitment to residential sales support before opening.**

Savills estimates a **33% global average premium** for branded residences and a **39% resort average**, but expressly cautions that brand alone is insufficient: location, execution and operating quality determine whether the premium is realized. ([pdf.savills.com](https://pdf.savills.com/documents/Savills-Branded-Residences-Annual-Report-2025-2026.pdf))

**Bottom line:** For a globally marketable luxury project, begin with **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood, Aman, Raffles and Waldorf Astoria**. Add **One&Only or Six Senses** for resort/wellness, **Fairmont, JW Marriott, Conrad or Park Hyatt** for broader luxury economics, and **EDITION, W, SLS, Andaz or Thompson** when lifestyle differentiation is central.
